reviews.text: I brought my pug in for a nail trim, she is terrified and does not liked to be touched, let alone have her nails trimmed. We were lucky to find Elif, she was kind, took her time and praised my little girl constantly for her cooperation. I had little hope and was gonna accept just one nail trimmed but Elif managed to trim/file all of them. We will be back! Thank you so much!!!

Scruffie loves seeing Elif at SuperGrooms! She takes such good care of him and his needs (he’s a blind older doggie). Love their new College Street location as it’s walkable for us. Great care, attention to detail and kindness.
The most personal and understanding groomer I've found. Will be returning.
They do a great job, personalized to each pet they look after. The new premises are great, nice to get grooming out of the basement.

Elif did a phenomenal job with my beloved dog Muin. It was the first time in 9 years that she had a full grooming experience. Muin was quite matted after a canoe trip and now looks amazing and was so at ease after her experience. Highly recommend Elif for her caring and attentive ways that made it a good experience for Muin.

Our little dog gets so nervous with people but the team at SuperGrooms puts her so at ease and she's always happy and waggy when we pick her up after the appointment, even if she was nervous going in.

We brought in our Labradoodle Yuki for her first grooming in a while. She has a heart condition and the last grooming (at another company) was so stressful that she was hospitalized. Today was great. Kind, gentle, patient, and well done. Yuki looks great with minimal stress. Highly recommended!

Judith is the best groomer that we have had for our 140lbs Tibetan Mastiff. She takes the time and makes sure he is comfortable and has a good experience. She also puts in the effort to brush out any matting that he has rather than shaving off sections that would permanently damage his coat. We have been to other groomers before who were not knowledgeable about the breed and ended up causing damage. Judith is very knowledgeable and also helped our dog over come any sensitivity and trust issues from his prior grooming experiences at other places.

My anxious dog loves going here! After being traumatized by a groomer as a puppy we struggled for years to groom our poodle mix. We groomed her at home but due to my aging pup and parents, continuing with home haircuts became significantly more difficult. SuperGrooms has been truly life changing for my family. As a caregiver with limited time, this has reduced my stress and to-do list significantly, while my dog can get the haircut she deserves and be respected by the lovely individuals who work here! I highly recommend :)

My tiny and scared pooch had an incredible spa day and was able to be comforted by me the entire time! Elif was so kind, gentle and skilled. Judith is lovely. Can’t wait to see when their new place is finished. Sounds like it will be very special. Looking forward to coming back!

Thank you for the 4-star review! We appreciate the feedback. We want every visit to be flawless, so if there is anything we can do to earn that 5th star next time, please let us know. Since we can't find your name in our customer database, please feel free to contact us directly to share your experience. Thanks again!

Really positive first time experience here! The groomer was so friendly and gentle towards our dog. She gave her a very cute groom and followed our inspo picture perfectly. We also received text updates along the way to let us know how our dog was doing during the session. Thank you!

Friendly professional service that emphasizes a fear-free environment for our Bernedoodle. The one on one model of their grooming service makes a big difference. Much appreciated and highly recommended without hesitation. Best grooming service we’ve ever used!!
SuperGrooms is the best groomer in town! We’ve been using them for over two years and they truly care about our dog. They understand him and do an amazing job with his wash, nail trim, and more.
Great service! My dog morkie has got the best haircut ever! Very nice and gentle towards dogs especially shy dogs as my puppy Daisy..

Thank you Elif for taking such great care of my dog. He’s a very picky Pomeranian and Elif was so caring and nice since the moment we walked in. I’ve never seen my dog so calm and looking so good after a groom. Elif went about and beyond by saying she already knows how my Pom is for the next time we come by which shows that she really cares about the dogs. I am really thankful, I feel so at ease that I found this place and Elif! Thank you

We had such an amazing experience with Judit! My 10-month-old pup recently became very difficult during nail trims and wouldn’t let us touch her paws. I was worried it would turn into a long-term issue, but Judit completely put my mind at ease. She listened carefully to all of my concerns, handled my dog with patience and confidence, and had her finished in under 20 minutes.

She also took the time to share helpful tips on how to make my pup more comfortable with handling at home. I’m so happy we found this place! Highly recommend. Thank you, Judit!

This is a great place for a grooming. Very talented groomer and she gave my dog lots of extra care and attention. My dog (who is a bit anxious)came home so happy and beautiful. She clearly was treated well and the grooming was exceptional.

Love Super Grooms
Not only does my dog look great but he is happy when he comes out. Great value for the quality and care
Tara and Bear

Thank you to Elif and the team at SuperGrooms for doing such an amazing job with our Lyla!! Our husky is an anxious girl and so we were a bit nervous bringing her to a new groomer since we moved downtown. But we received regular text updates during her appointment and were so pleased when we picked her up. I’m certain she is 10 pounds lighter now with all the fur they helped brush out!

SuperGrooms didn’t an amazing job with our anxious English Springer Spaniel! They were able to clear out all his matting delicately and patiently. They specialize in reactive dogs, strongly recommend.
Absolutely love them!! My pup is a bit skittish and he’s never had a problem because they’re so good with him here. And he comes back happy, smooth, and looking good!

Super Groomer really are super each and every time they’ve done An amazing job on my baby Ella. She is a 7yr. Old Great Dane that used to to be afraid of having a bath, and now walks in no problem, and loves the attention she gets. 🤩😍❤️5 start all the way! …

Raphael is the happiest little guy, but he is a rescue and has certain little particularities. Judit understood this from the moment she met him; he's always greeted with the exact energy he needs to feel safe & secure. Raph and I have been regulars for over a year, and I am so thankful for the care and attention he receives here. A billion stars for Judit's pup-whispering grooming service!
Thank you so much! We really appreciate it
Thanks a lot! Your support means a lot to us

Judit was absolutely amazing! She was so loving and gentle with Luna, and incredibly skilled. Luna’s tail and bum were very matted, and the transformation was impressive. My beautiful husky came out looking gorgeous, clean, and fresh. And she was genuinely happy when I picked her up, even though she’s not a fan of water. I’m so grateful for the care and attention Judit gave her. Highly recommend!

After my little Lola was fired by one groomer, and gave the second a run for her money, for being extremely anxious and not staying still, I finally found a place where she is happy, and calm, and less anxious, and praised for her spunky little personality. Elif was so open and welcoming and made Lola feel at home. She gave her time to sniff her surroundings and get comfortable. I love that she kept me updated by text throughout the grooming process. She even finished her in a 2 hour timeframe and waived the behaviour handling fee because Lola gave her no issues. Beyond happy that we finally found Lola’s place!
Wonderful experience! Great staff & great quality of care :) Highly recommended!

I came here specifically for my very nervous 12 pound dog to get a nail trim.  After a recent nail injury are, Groomer said they couldn’t trim his nails, and our vet suggested that he be fully put under for nail trims.  After reading reviews, I decided to come here Because I had read some great reviews.

I went in with high expectations, and I left so happy.  The Groomer made a point to meet both me and my dog, and also to hear about his specific challenges.  I felt so comfortable and, more importantly, my dog had time to get comfortable.  The groomer also partnered with me to try different ways to make my dog more comfortable.  You could see how much she cared for him and also loves what she does.  She also talked me through a plan to make my dog more comfortable. I will be coming back and will also recommend this place to anyone who needs a more collaborative approach for pet grooming.

Now, my dog would say that he had a terrible time, but that the treats were good, the facility was spacious, the water was fresh and that the groomer was friendly.
My Son's hair looks amazing +10 Stars

My 1yo doberman HATES getting her nails cut. She wont tolerate it from me nor the vet (last time I tried with the vet they sent me home because she was too hysterical). I took her to Judit and she was in and out in less than 5 minutes - no stress at all. I'm not sure what magic she possesses but I was floored. Will 100% be back.
This place deserves 10 stars! Judith did an amazing job on my pup, I will 100% bring him back for a groom. We had a little bath today and he smells so good and clean.
My very anxious dog is so well taken care of when he gets groomed here 💙 …

What a wonderful spot! I was travelling and apprehensive about taking my dog somewhere new, but Elif took such great care of her - the whole thing was seamless and my pup came out looking so cute! Thank you!!

Judit is an amazing groomer! Until today, no one had been able to complete the grooming for my anxious dog — but that changed today! From now on, you’re the only place we’ll go. Thank you for the wonderful service!
Judit was incredibly patient with our frightened dog and made a stressful experience into a happy one! Very grateful.
Judit is the best! We trust that our dog will come back tag wagging and excited to show off his new look!! Love the before and after photos!! Highly recommend for terriers that need hand stripping
Thanks so much for the 5‑star review!

Brought my dog here for the first time today and couldn’t be more pleased!! I’ve been looking for a new groomer who prioritizes safety, and supergrooms caught my eye since all their grooming services are 1 on 1. I’m also so impressed that they give an update via text after their bath! Great experience!! This will definitely be my new spot, thanks so much Elif!
Such a great groomer! They genuinely love dogs and take such good care
Gussy, my mini poodle, loves Elif – the best groomer we’ve ever had. Elif does a great cut and is so kind and caring of Gussy.
Excellent grooming.  Easy online appointment, friendly atmosphere.

We’ve had a hard time finding a grooming place for our dog, Loki, who is extremely anxious, and this was really our last hope. Our groomer, Elif, was absolutely incredible - so caring, patient, and positive in how she worked with him. While Loki was still nervous, everything went so much better than we ever imagined. We’re so grateful and highly recommend this place, and especially Elif, to anyone, whether your dog is anxious or not.
My pup looks amazing! He’s a happy pup. Thank you Elif

Honestly, the best grooming my standard poodle has ever had. After a horrible experience with a different groomer, this experience and the attention to my dogs needs was nothing short of incredible. Thanks so much. We will be back.
Elif does a beautiful job and is wonderful with  dogs.

Judit was amazing with my dog Lenny! He is quite anxious and is a senior rescue with cognitive changes, and Judit was so gentle and did such a great job at grooming him. He previously was unable to be groomed at another facility due to his anxiety, but Super Grooms is such a calm environment and the staff do such a good job to ensure your pet is safe and feels comfortable during the groom. It was our first time at this shop and we will definitely be coming back in the future ☺️

Had a fantastic experience at SuperGrooms. Judit took the time to listen to my concerns, treated my pup with compassion, and educated me on how to keep making the grooming process less stressful for my portie. Would definitely recommend, especially if your pup does better with one on one attention. Thank you Judit!

Judit is awesome. She’s passionate about dogs and grooming. She’s very patient with Miguel, who can be difficult with his nail cutting but Judit is always so sweet about Miguel’s grooming sessions and not frustrated. Thank you Judit for making Miguel feel safe and comfortable while grooming. The grooming experience for Miguel is the most important thing to me because I don’t want him to feel scared or dislike it more than he already does. But what’s even better is that not only is the experience great, Judit is also really good at giving Miguel the haircut we want. He always comes out looking cute and fresh.

Wow this service is amazing, my female dog 🐕 is astonished! Beautiful and clean... l love this space  l have another dog and l will take him soon.  By the way my dog is Siberian Husky and they said she has been the most well behaved Husky.  I am sure she is. …
Judit’s passion for proper grooming techniques is truly commendable. Our Irish Terrier has seldom looked so handsome and is looking forward to his next visit!

I just had my first visit to SuperGrooms on Queen, and it was fantastic! The groomer was so kind and gentle with my dog, who was feeling a bit anxious and also dealing with a healing cut on her abdomen and an ear infection. She handled everything with such care and compassion. I really appreciated the detailed consultation before the grooming as well as during and thoughtful feedback afterward. The groomer texted me directly when she was ready for pickup! The pricing was very reasonable and included everything—bath, haircut, nail trim, etc. They sent a summary of the appointment afterwards with before-and-after photos, which was such a lovely touch. Very cute and clean shop, I’ll definitely be back!
Great experience with both my dogs. They are quite nervous and we appreciated the updates while they were being groomed. Very thorough job, thank you!

Elif did a wonderful job grooming our corgi, Honey! Very friendly and welcoming staff, and really appreciated the text updates throughout the grooming process. Honey was happy as ever and clearly had a great time, plus she looks so fresh and clean! Thanks for a great experience :)

I brought my nervous rescue dog for her first groom today and was so incredibly happy with the entire process from start to finish! Judit took the time to learn about my anxious dog before she took her in for grooming, I got texted photos and updates along the way, I received a little report card afterwards, and my dog looks absolutely amazing. I am relieved to find a groomer that my dog loves and who did an amazing job! I have already recommended SuperGrooms to all my friends with dogs :)

Fantastic job grooming my Old English Goldendoodle which is not the easiest breed to groom! He is still a puppy and they were obviously very gentle with him. They listened to my requests and it turned out even better than I hoped!
We had a wonderful first experience at Supergrooms today!. Ms. Gus loved Judit who gave her a great cut and in less than 2 hours. See you soon!
Left us with one super fluffy pup! Did a great job!
Elif is great at her job and always treats cookie with so much love and care ❤️
Thank you so much! We are really glad you had a great experience ☺️
Judit is the best!!!
Our senior pup looks and feels fabulous after her visit!
Amazing staff and they did a great job with Ollie. Thank you!

We had our Bernese Darla in for a groom & she was gorgeous and shiny when I picked her up. Judit is friendly, informative and made sure to let Darla warm up to her before taking her back for her service. She also took the time to share any concerns or comments she had with me afterwards! Would recommend!
Judit did a great job! The grooming process was seamless and Judit is so lovely. Cara looks adorable with her new cut :)
Thank you so much! ⭐️ Truly appreciated! 😊 …
Thank you ☺️
11/10 experience. Best groomer in the City!

The way that my dog absolutely pulls me all the way when he knows he’s going to see Judit, that should tell you everything you need to know about how much she cares, and loves, the pets that come to her for grooming. She is attentive, caring, and truly just takes the time to make sure it’s a good experience for both pets and pet parents. You’ve got a long time fan in Teddy, Judit!

Wow! Judit is so wonderful! My chihuahua papillon loved her so much! It is very obvious that she loves what she does, and her talent shines through the exemplary results! I’m never going anywhere else!
Photos show before, during and after!

Brought my dog for her first groom at SuperGrooms today and she looks fantastic! Moose is a bit nervous and shy and I felt completely at ease leaving her in Elifs care. Elif treated her like royalty, spoiled her, kept me updated and even gave me the cutest report card! Moose is already excited for her next groom with Elif - Thank you!
She is amazing with my dog and has given the best cuts !  Everyone compliments my little yorkies grooming since i switched to this groomer!  Love ❤️

This is THE BEST place to groom your dogs! Our anxious pup Mochi has been there twice and they have taken great care both times. They are so so good with anxious and restless doggies. You get the report with pictures and it’s the cutest thing ever 💜 …

I cannot express enough how wonderful Judit at SuperGrooms was with my senior dog! My dog has some health problems and high anxiety and Judit was so lovely and caring with my pup! She even sent an update about how my pup was doing during the appointment. I would highly highly recommend this company for dog grooming! You can be confident your dog will be in great hands!!
Took such wonderful care and groomed my nervous little one so well!
Thank you ☺️

Judit is amazing. She’s extremely accommodating and takes such great care of my doggy. He always comes back looking very handsome and tired from all the fun he had. Thank you so much Judit. Mylo appreciates you!!
